newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cloncurry copper output hit by floods.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cloncurry copper output hit by floods.

text.p: Australian copper producer Cloncurry Mining Co NL said torrential rainfall over the past four to five days had caused a suspension of mining and crushing operations from last Friday.
Severe flooding had occurred in the Cloncurry area in the northwest of the state of Queensland, it said.
Acid consumption and power usage had been minimised since Sunday, while circulation of leach solution to the plant was stopped Sunday afternoon.
Six out of 14 heaps had been washed out and required repair, it said.
Copper stripping had been deferred from Monday to Thursday pending recommencement of full operations.
The impact on copper cathode production was being evaluated, while damage to heaps and loss or delay of production was being discussed with insurance agents, it said.
All equipment remained in full operational condition and was safe from flooding, it said.
Normal production could occur about 24 hours after rain stopped, it said.
Cloncurry produced 4,055 tonnes of copper cathode in calendar 1996.
The company's shares rose by 2.5 cents to 22 cents on the Australian Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
